fields.label: New Conversation Timeout (Hours)
fields.description: After this many hours of no new incoming message, a reply starts a new ticket instead of continuing the old one.

fields.label: Placeholder Email Domain
fields.description: Domain used for auto-generated email addresses when a WhatsApp contact has no email.

fields.label: Status on Customer Reply
fields.description: Set ticket to this status when a customer sends a WhatsApp message.

fields.label: Status on Agent Reply
fields.description: Set ticket to this status when an agent sends a WhatsApp reply.

fields.label: Notification Quiet Period (Minutes)
fields.description: Skip the bell notification if an agent already replied to this ticket within this many minutes. Set to 0 to always notify.

fields.label: Send Initial Message on New Ticket
Initial Message Template
fields.description: WhatsApp Template sent automatically when a new ticket is created. Variables: {{1}} = contact name, {{2}} = ticket ID.

fields.label: Allow Template Messages After 24h Window
fields.description: When the 24-hour customer service window expires, agents can send approved WhatsApp templates to restart the conversation. These are billed by Meta as business-initiated conversations.

fields.label: Allowed Templates
fields.description: Restrict agents to only these templates when the 24h window is expired. Leave empty to allow all templates.

fields.label: Product List
fields.description: One product per line. Used to populate the Product field on tickets via the welcome template.
